          About this map

          Posted signs always win. This is the city's published schedule, and it can lag behind a sign change or miss a temporary closure.

          Schedule

          Street Sweeping Schedule from San Francisco Public Works, published on DataSF. This copy was downloaded : schedule rows covering curb sides. All times are San Francisco time.

          Holidays

          Following SFMTA's enforcement calendar: nothing is ticketed on New Year's Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas. On other city holidays, daytime sweeping (6 AM and later) is not enforced, and overnight sweeping still is. Skipped dates are crossed out in each curb's list. Dates after 2026 follow the same pattern and are not yet confirmed by SFMTA.

          Gaps

          Gray dashed curbs have parking rules on file but no sweeping schedule in the city's data, mostly on Russian Hill, Nob Hill and North Beach. Streets missing entirely, such as park roads and the Presidio, are not in the dataset. Bike-lane sweeping is not included.

          Your location
